cues.text:
Nee dokka ni oitekita you na koto ga
Hey, things I seem to have left somewhere
cues.japanese: ねぇ どっかに置いてきたような事が
cues.translation: Hey, things I seem to have left somewhere
cues.romaji: Nee dokka ni oitekita you na koto ga

cues.text:
Hitotsu futatsu uiteiru kedo
One or two are floating up, but...
cues.japanese: 一つ二つ浮いているけど
cues.translation: One or two are floating up, but...

cues.text:
Nee chanto hirotteokou
Hey, let's make sure we pick them up
cues.japanese: ねぇ ちゃんと拾っておこう
cues.translation: Hey, let's make sure we pick them up

cues.text:
Hajikete wasureteshimau mae ni
Before they burst and we forget
cues.japanese: はじけて忘れてしまう前に
cues.translation: Before they burst and we forget

cues.text:
Mawaridashita ano ko to boku no mirai ga tomari
The future set in motion for that girl and me comes to a stop
cues.japanese: 回り出した あの子と僕の未来が止まり
cues.translation: The future set in motion for that girl and me comes to a stop
cues.romaji: Mawaridashita ano ko to boku no mirai ga tomari

cues.text:
Dokka de mata yarinaosetara
If only we could start over somewhere
cues.japanese: どっかで またやり直せたら
cues.translation: If only we could start over somewhere

cues.text:
Mawaridashita ano ko to boku ga higaisha zura de
That girl and I, set in motion, playing the victims
cues.japanese: 回り出した あの子と僕が被害者面で
cues.translation: That girl and I, set in motion, playing the victims
cues.romaji: Mawaridashita ano ko to boku ga higaisha zura de

cues.text:
Dokka wo mata neriaruketara na
If only we could wander somewhere again
cues.japanese: どっかを また練り歩けたらな
cues.translation: If only we could wander somewhere again

cues.text:
Ano ne watashi anata ni atta no
You know, I met you
cues.japanese: あのね 私あなたに会ったの
cues.translation: You know, I met you
cues.romaji: Ano ne watashi anata ni atta no

cues.text:
Yume no naka ni oitekita kedo ne
Though I left it behind inside a dream
cues.japanese: 夢の中に置いてきたけどね
cues.translation: Though I left it behind inside a dream
cues.romaji: Yume no naka ni oitekita kedo ne

cues.text:
Nee doushite watashi ga suki nano
Hey, why do you like me?
cues.japanese: ねぇ どうして私が好きなの
cues.translation: Hey, why do you like me?
cues.romaji: Nee doushite watashi ga suki nano

cues.text:
Ichido shika atta koto ga nai no ni ne
Even though we've only met once
cues.japanese: 一度しか会ったことがないのにね
cues.translation: Even though we've only met once
cues.romaji: Ichido shika atta koto ga nai no ni ne

cues.text:
Omoi wo kette futaride shitenda
We kick our feelings aside, the two of us
cues.japanese: 思いを蹴って 二人でしてんだ
cues.translation: We kick our feelings aside, the two of us

cues.text:
Kowarenai ai wo utau
We sing of a love that won't break
cues.japanese: 壊れない愛を歌う
cues.translation: We sing of a love that won't break

cues.text:
Kotoba wo futari ni kashite chikai wo tatenda
We bind ourselves with words and make a vow
cues.japanese: 言葉を二人に課して 誓いをたてんだ
cues.translation: We bind ourselves with words and make a vow
cues.romaji: Kotoba wo futari ni kashite chikai wo tatenda

cues.text:
Wasurenai ai wo utau you ni ne
So we can sing of a love we won't forget
cues.japanese: 忘れない愛を歌うようにね
cues.translation: So we can sing of a love we won't forget
cues.romaji: Wasurenai ai wo utau you ni ne

Jidai ni notte bokutachi wa
Riding the times, we
cues.japanese: 時代に乗って僕たちは
cues.translation: Riding the times, we

cues.text:
Kawarazu ai ni ikiru darou
Will go on living for love, unchanged
cues.japanese: 変わらず愛に生きるだろう
cues.translation: Will go on living for love, unchanged

cues.text:
Bokura ga chitte nokoru no wa
When we're scattered, what remains
cues.japanese: 僕らが散って残るのは
cues.translation: When we're scattered, what remains
cues.romaji: Bokura ga chitte nokoru no wa

cues.text:

cues.japanese: 変わらぬ愛の歌なんだろうな
cues.translation: Will be a song of unchanging love, I suppose
cues.romaji: Kawaranu ai no uta nandarou na
